content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Qualified Member of Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI); Qualified Member of Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI); Qualified Member of Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI); Master of Business Administration (Finance) Experience: 1-year post-qualification experience in finance/accounts Age limit: Maximum 40 years (as on the last date for submission of application) Other conditions: Applicant should have a valid personal email ID, kept active at least till the engagement process is complete. Working hours are 09.00 AM to 05.30 PM, Monday to Friday; late sitting or holiday work may be needed. Attendance is through the Biometric Attendance System. The contractual person is subject to the Official Secret Act, 1923. Desirable: Excellent communication, interpersonal and analytical skill Good working knowledge of technology-based skills on the computer and ability to work on ICT Experience in working with Central or State Government Ministry/Department/Autonomous body

content_sections.heading: CRCS Young Professionals (Finance) Job Description
content_sections.text: Examination of audited financial statements of Multi-State Cooperative Societies along with verification of adherence to relevant accounting standards, statutory requirement of MSCS Act, 2002, identifications of qualification raised by Statutory Auditors and etc. Examination of inspection reports of Multi-State Co-operative Societies, cross-verification of findings with financial statement and audit reports, assessment of compliance of Statutory provisions of MSCS Act, 2002. Assessment of financial health and sustainability of Multi-State Co-operative Societies based on financial ratios, fund management, liquidity status and overall performance. Identification of risks, financial irregularities or mismanagement in the Multi-State Co-operative Societies. Furnishing observations on any other issue emerging from the audit or inspection reports which may be relevant for regulatory, supervisory, or administrative purposes. Providing recommendations or remedial actions based on findings.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initially for one (01) year, extendable by another one year based on performance. Purely on contract basis, with no right to regular appointment, absorption or regularization. In the normal course, one month's notice or one month's pay in lieu before termination by CRCS. An employee leaving early must give 60 days' notice or two months' salary in lieu. 12 days Casual Leave for one year on pro rata basis; unused leave is neither carried forward nor encashed.

content_sections.heading: How Will CRCS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Preliminary short listing on the basis of academic records/experience etc. Interview/personal discussion of shortlisted candidates Meeting the eligibility criteria does not entitle an applicant to be called for interview/personal discussion. Office of CRCS may make a preliminary short listing on the basis of academic records/experience etc. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview/personal discussion.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of all requisite documents Latest photo Self-attested copies of certificates and mark sheets from 10th Standard onwards Valid documentary evidence of previous employment/experience

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CRCS Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill in the prescribed proforma annexed to the notice. Attach self-attested copies of all requisite documents and the latest photo. Write "Application for the post of Young Professionals (Finance)" on the envelope. Send the hard copy by registered post to the Section Officer (Admn.), O/o CRCS, New Delhi. Send a scanned copy of the application to [email protected] . Make sure it reaches by 19 November 2026.
